name: primer-paso-ahorro-medido
description: Prototipo para el reto técnico de Agora Partnerships: primer paso con ahorro medido.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,mocks,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @ppam/api" "npm run dev -w @ppam/mocks" "npm run dev -w @ppam/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p packages/fixtures && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/mocks && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p scripts
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run trace && npm run build && npm run test:bundle && npm run test:e2e
